stops.title: Cross House
stops.description: In 1839, Edward Hopkins, the Superintendent of the Newport Police who arrested Frost after the Rising, lived in a house at this site. It also served as a police station. After the battle at the Westgate, more than 150 weapons abandoned by the Chartists were collected and brought to Hopkins' home.

stops.title: Newport Rising Hub
stops.description: The Newport Rising Hub on Commercial Street is part community space, part historical interpretation centre. Inside you will find an exhibition of radical history, interactive exhibits including an AI John Frost, Chartist books and merchandise, and a programme of events from talks to live music.
